description: What the local tools suite must notice about edit_file with several edits: edits applied to the original text instead of the evolving one, a failing edit skipped instead of nothing written, the failure not saying which edit, edits that cancel out written, the two forms mixed, no cap on the number of edits, replace_all of one edit ignored, a missing form not named, CRLF doubled, the receipt without the number of edits.

mutations.name: E1
mutations.what: each edit is applied to the original text instead of the text the edits before it left

mutations.name: E2
mutations.what: an edit that does not fit is skipped and the others are written (not all or nothing)

patches.old: } catch (failure) { throw many ? this.#editFailure(failure, index, list.length) : failure; }

mutations.name: E3
mutations.what: the failure does not say which edit it was

patches.old: `Chỉnh sửa ${index + 1}/${total} thất bại, chưa ghi gì: ${error.message}`

mutations.name: E4
mutations.what: edits that cancel out are written anyway and reported as a change

mutations.name: E5
mutations.what: old_string and edits are accepted together

patches.old: ? ['chỉ dùng một trong hai cách: hoặc old_string + new_string, hoặc edits; không dùng cả hai'] : [];

mutations.name: E7
mutations.what: replace_all of one edit is ignored

mutations.name: E8
mutations.what: a call with neither form is not told what is missing

patches.old: return oldString === undefined || newString === undefined ? ['cần old_string + new_string hoặc edits (danh sách chỉnh sửa)'] : [];

mutations.name: E9
mutations.what: CRLF inside the new text of an edit is written twice over (\r\r\n)

patches.old: newString: crlf ? toLf(edit.new_string) : edit.new_string, replaceAll: edit.replace_all }

mutations.name: E10
mutations.what: the receipt does not say how many edits there were

patches.old: { path: target.relative, edits: list.length, replacements: count, firstLine, sha256: digest, previousSha: before });
patches.new: { path: target.relative, replacements: count, firstLine, sha256: digest, previousSha: before });

mutations.name: E11
mutations.what: validate() (the check made before an approval is asked) ignores the rule across the fields

patches.old: return errors.length === 0 ? { ok: true, errors: [] } : { ok: false, code: 'invalid_arguments', errors };
patches.new: return checked.ok ? { ok: true, errors: [] } : { ok: false, code: 'invalid_arguments', errors };

mutations.name: E12
mutations.what: call() runs a call whose form is wrong when its schema is right

mutations.name: E13
mutations.what: the rule across the fields is never asked of the tool
